title: The Deliveries -- five story-led post packages after "The Second Delivery"
status: PRODUCTION DRAFT -- not official canon. Plan, text and prompts only: no image, audio, upload, schedule, publish, spend or setting change. Does not alter brand/season_arcs/season_1.json, any content_items numbering, or any established room or lock fact.
revised: 2026-10-08 -- visual direction re-based on the approved Nyx reference package; hard-coded door hardware, room layout, envelope colour and sleeve length removed; 4 masters per package (20 in total).
author: Claude (Nyx_Emberfall branch claude/serene-carson-2ywitf)
open_questions_for_the_founder: The approved Nyx reference package is not in this repository. Every frame must be generated with it attached, and QA compares every frame against it. Add its images (or their paths) before the first sitting.
"The Second Delivery" is a production-draft anchor that assumes the s1e02 vote resolved to the default 'open it'. It is not in season_1.json and takes no episode number from it.
The black ribbon and key belong to the reference package. Their story meaning is not decided here: they appear unchanged wherever the reference places them and are never named in the voiceover.
No content_items index is assigned. Numbering happens only when a package is promoted.

anchor_episode.label: The Second Delivery (production-draft anchor; not numbered, not in season_1.json)
anchor_episode.assumption: The s1e02 public fork resolved to the default 'open it'.
beats: Same night, straight after s1e02. She opens the first envelope, sitting on the floor at the low table.
Inside: one torn corner of an old printed star chart, one small cluster circled in ink. No writing, no name.
She lays the chart corner on the low table beside the opened envelope.
A soft scrape at the door. A second envelope has come under it, into the warm strip of hallway light. This one has two inked starbursts.
She picks it up and does not open the door. She sets it, unopened, on the low table with the others.

end_state.chart_fragment: on the low table beside the first envelope

does_not_resolve: what the ribbon and key are for

reference.authority: The approved Nyx reference package is the visual authority for every frame: Nyx's face and body, her dark fur (fox ears and tail), wardrobe, the black cat, the moonlit window, the low-table and floor staging, the black ribbon and key, the door and every piece of architecture. Text in this plan says WHAT HAPPENS; the reference says WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE. On any conflict the reference wins and the frame is rejected.
attach: every image in the approved Nyx reference package
reference.identity_source: brand/nyx_identity/identity_spec.json (reference_primary is the identity QA source)
preserve: Nyx exactly as the reference: same face, amber eyes, dark hair, beauty mark on her anatomical left cheek, adult (25+)
her dark fur: exactly two fox ears on top of her head and exactly one fox tail, fur colour and pattern as the reference; no human ears, no earrings
wardrobe exactly as the reference: dark/black top, dark jeans, pendant necklace only
the black cat, exactly as the reference; never a second animal
the moonlit window exactly as the reference: same shape, same view, a visible moon
the low table and the floor-level staging exactly as the reference
the black ribbon and key exactly as the reference: same place, same look, never moved, duplicated, recoloured or removed
the door, its hardware and the strip of hallway light beneath it exactly as the reference and the approved s1e02 frames
every piece of architecture, furniture and decor as the reference shows it: nothing added, moved or redesigned
night only: warm lamp and candle light against cool moonlight
reference.never_specify: Prompts never describe door hardware, locks, room geometry, furniture layout, wardrobe cut or fur colour in their own words. They point at the reference.
reference.text_in_image: No legible letters, words, numbers, addresses, stamps or logos in any generated image. Overlay lines are added afterwards.
